Generate fraction-specific analyte aliases

Source: R/analytes.R
dot-add_fraction_aliases.Rd

Creates common environmental laboratory reporting variants for analyte names by appending fraction descriptors.

Usage

.add_fraction_aliases(
  alias,
  fractions = c("dissolved", "total", "filtered", "unfiltered")
)

Arguments

x

Character vector of analyte names or abbreviations.

Value

A character vector containing the original values and common fraction-specific variants.

Details

The following suffixes are generated:

- `"dissolved"` - `"total"` - `"filtered"` - `"unfiltered"`

This helper is primarily used when constructing [analyte_tbl] and [analyte_alias_lookup].

Examples

.add_fraction_aliases(c("ca", "calcium"))
#> Error in .add_fraction_aliases(c("ca", "calcium")): could not find function ".add_fraction_aliases"

# Returns aliases such as:
# "ca"
# "ca dissolved"
# "ca total"
# "calcium dissolved"
